name: Authentication Failure Burst
description: Detects repeated failed authentication attempts against the same account from the same source.

name: Failed Authentication Followed by Success
description: Detects repeated failed authentication attempts followed by a successful login for the same account and source.

name: Encoded PowerShell Execution
description: Detects PowerShell execution containing encoded command arguments.

name: Suspicious Authentication Followed by PowerShell
description: Correlates suspicious authentication activity with subsequent PowerShell execution on the same host and account.
